title: Download scoped quotation currency summaries as PDF
description: A user downloads the all-matching original-currency summary from the quotation designer as PDF with the same selected metrics and applied filter context as the summary Excel. Add a dedicated summary PDF endpoint to the existing controller and a narrow Infrastructure exporter using existing PDFsharp and SimHeiPdfFontResolver, with no dependency/font/config changes. Independently reauthorize and validate through the existing preview path and render only server-derived ERP-209 summaries; paginate wide metric columns and rows, preserve selected metric order and explicit empty evidence, and label all-matching bounded-source coverage. Never combine currencies or show unselected monetary metrics. Missing font or rendering errors must fail clearly with no corrupt file. Add a distinct designer summary PDF action retaining current fields/filters and showing failed downloads; keep current-page PDF behavior intact. Development only: reuse current authenticated ERP identity, the existing quotation menu and freshly resolved SalespersonDataScopeService; audit every endpoint through existing OperationLogMiddleware. No permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table or business writes, new entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure edits, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env changes, deployment, irreversible operations or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and work. Run focused in-memory/service/API/export/UI source-contract tests and configured safe Release build/test; mark unavailable external environments blocked rather than inventing success.
acceptance_criteria: Summary PDF independently validates and rechecks current identity/quotation-menu/customer scope before obtaining server-derived per-currency summaries; invalid/revoked/source-overflow requests return no file.

The Infrastructure exporter renders selected metric order, normalized filters/dates, all-matching coverage, currency/unknown groups, empty evidence and row/column pagination; unselected money and mixed-currency totals are absent and font/render errors fail explicitly.
Designer summary PDF keeps current fields/filters and surfaces errors while existing current-page PDF stays compatible; focused PDF/UI tests and safe Release build/test pass.
